```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
#| message: false
mallards |>
  count(month, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(ggridges)

mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = month, fill = month)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 1.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Speed",
    y = "Month",
    title = "Distribution of mallard speeds by month",
    fill = "Month"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
